scientific_integrity: Originality assessment is relative to inspected published sources and exact previous-claim comparisons. Exhaustive checks are finite and do not independently establish asymptotic results. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The joint rank–support formula applies to the canonical labeled path graphical alternating matrix space over any finite field. The group interpretation is restricted to odd prime fields and abelian subgroups containing the derived subgroup; support is presentation dependent. The central limit theorem takes path length to infinity at fixed field order and fixed positive rank. The unweighted rank enumerator alone is prior-derived; possible broader weighted enumerations remain a publication-priority risk.
title: Rank–support enumeration and Gaussian laws for abelian subgroups of path graphical groups
